name: Scanline
idea: A solid barcode block whose bars break around the letters CNX, read by an electric-cyan scan line across its lower band.
why: It is the one graphic every parcel already carries, so on a label, tape or van side it says shipping instantly, while the knocked-out word makes it unmistakably CNX.
risks: The bars borrow the bar widths of the real Code 128 symbol for CNX with the spaces closed up, so the logo itself does not scan; the dense block is heavy, the app icon turns grey below about 32 px, and on 203-dpi labels it needs roughly 30 mm of width for even bars.
